summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for artist social-links rules, release wizard integration, submit authority, admin detail social rendering, WhatsApp follow-up template/status localization, Annual/PPR regression, RBAC read-only, KYC, and mobile responsiveness using public URL.
action_items: No blocking defects found in tested scope; keep iter58 fixture script for future regression reruns if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Artist social-link validation path is consistently enforced across create/update/submit and properly rejects legacy artist credits without socials at submit time.
Release submit uses authoritative stored artist profile (stored artist name/social snapshot overrides client-manipulated payload), which mitigates client-side tampering.
Admin workflow status labels and actions remain Indonesian in UI while backend enum/status values stay stable (draft/submitted/under_review/approved/rejected/delivered/live/taken_down).

success_rate.frontend: 98% (all targeted flows passed; one intermediate mobile run failed due role mismatch in test navigation, not product defect)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary fixture via /app/tests/iter58_ui_fixture.py (seed/cleanup) including seeded verified label, saved+legacy artists, and one submitted release for admin/detail WhatsApp checks; cleanup executed successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/iter58_ui_fixture.py seed before UI checks and cleanup after. Verified: legacy artist warning in wizard, new artist multi-link validation, admin WhatsApp template changes by status (Diajukan -> Sedang Ditinjau -> Perlu Revisi with note), and no mobile overflow on tested label/admin screens.
rca of the issue: No product bug RCA required in this run because no backend/frontend functional defect was reproduced in tested scope.
